title: Profile list, row layout, search, reorder, delete, share popup

controls.label: Profiles
controls.action: Shows the toolbar, the profile list, and transient snackbars.

controls.label: Profiles
controls.action: Shows the screen title.

controls.label: Add Profile
controls.action: Opens the add submenu.

controls.label: Scan QR code
controls.action: Starts the QR scanner activity.

controls.label: Import from Clipboard
controls.action: Parses ss:// URLs from the clipboard, creates each profile, and shows a result snackbar.

controls.label: Import from file…
controls.action: Opens a document picker that accepts any application or text document, and appends the profiles in the chosen files.

controls.label: Replace from file…
controls.action: Opens a document picker that accepts any application or text document, and creates the profiles in the chosen files; the first created profile clears the stored profiles.

controls.label: Manual Settings
controls.action: Creates a profile with the default host, port, password, and method, copies the current profile's feature settings to it, and opens its editor.

controls.label: Export…
controls.action: Opens the export submenu.

controls.label: Export to Clipboard
controls.action: Copies every active profile's ss:// URI, joined by newlines, and shows a result snackbar.

controls.label: Export to file…
controls.action: Opens a save picker and writes the profile JSON array.

controls.label: Search
controls.action: Expands a SearchView and filters the list as the text changes.

controls.label: Profile list
controls.action: Scrolls through the profile rows and hosts drag and swipe gestures. The list has no visible label. Its label is descriptive.

controls.label: profile row
controls.visible_when: the profile's subscription status is not Obsolete
controls.enabled_when: service state is Stopped, Connecting, or Connected
controls.action: Selects the profile and reloads the service when it can stop.

controls.label: profile name or address
controls.action: Shows the profile name, or host:port when the name is empty.

controls.label: address and plugin
controls.visible_when: the composed text is not empty
controls.action: Shows the address when the profile has a name, then a Plugin: line.

controls.label: traffic
controls.visible_when: tx is positive or rx is positive
controls.action: Shows sent and received bytes with up and down arrows.

controls.label: Edit
controls.visible_when: the profile is not an Active subscription profile
controls.enabled_when: service is Stopped or the profile is not active
controls.action: Reloads the profile and opens the profile editor.

controls.label: Subscriptions
controls.enabled_when: service is Stopped or the profile is not active
controls.action: Reloads the profile and opens the profile editor; it returns silently when the profile no longer exists.

controls.label: Share
controls.action: Opens the share popup menu.

controls.label: share popup
controls.action: Shows QR code and Export to Clipboard.

controls.label: QR code
controls.action: Opens a dialog with the profile's ss:// URI encoded as a QR code.

controls.label: Export to Clipboard
controls.action: Copies the profile's ss:// URI as sensitive text and shows a result snackbar.

controls.label: QR code
controls.visible_when: the QR code menu item is tapped
controls.action: Shows the profile URI as a QR image, or dismisses and reports an encoding error.

controls.label: QR code image
controls.action: Shows the 264dp QR bitmap, black modules on white.

controls.label: Removed
controls.visible_when: a row was swiped toward the start edge: left in an LTR locale, right in an RTL locale
controls.action: Reports the removal count and offers Undo.

controls.label: Undo
controls.action: Reinserts the removed rows and cancels the database deletion.

controls.label: result message
controls.visible_when: an import, export, file, or QR action reports a result
controls.action: Shows one line of success or failure text for a short time.

controls.label: Open file
controls.visible_when: Import from file or Replace from file is chosen
controls.enabled_when: a document provider handles the intent
controls.action: Lets the user pick one or more application or text documents.

controls.label: Save file
controls.enabled_when: a document provider handles the intent
controls.action: Lets the user pick a destination for profiles.json.

flows.name: Delete a profile and undo the deletion

steps.label: start: user swipes a row toward the start edge
steps.next: decision: profile editable?

steps.label: decision: profile editable? yes → remove the row, no → the swipe is refused
steps.next: yes -> system: remove the row from the adapter without a database delete | no -> end: the row stays in place

steps.label: system: remove the row from the adapter without a database delete
steps.next: system: show Removed or the items removed count with an Undo action

steps.label: system: show Removed or the items removed count with an Undo action
steps.next: decision: Undo pressed?

steps.label: decision: Undo pressed? yes → restore the rows, no → the snackbar dismisses
steps.next: yes -> system: undo reinserts the rows | no -> system: the dismiss callback runs ProfileManager.delProfile for each removed id

steps.label: system: undo reinserts the rows at their original indices and clears the recycle bin
steps.next: end: the profiles are restored

steps.label: end: the profiles are restored and never deleted
system: the dismiss callback runs ProfileManager.delProfile for each removed id
steps.next: end: the profiles are deleted

steps.label: end: the profiles are deleted from the database
end: the row stays in place

exceptions: An add, the first row crossover of a drag, view destruction, or a replacing snackbar dismisses the undo snackbar and commits the pending deletion. Another swipe does not: it adds to the recycle bin and shows a new snackbar over the old one.
Committing the delete of the selected profile leaves profileId pointing at the deleted id.

cases.title: Selecting a profile while stopped marks it and persists the choice
preconditions: Two profiles exist, Alpha and Beta.
Alpha is selected.
Service state is Stopped.
expected: Beta shows the selected background and Alpha loses it.
DataStore.profileId becomes the Beta id.
No service reload is sent because the state cannot stop.

cases.title: Selecting another profile while connected restarts the tunnel with it
preconditions: Service state is Connected with Alpha.
Beta exists.
expected: Beta becomes selected.
Core.switchProfile writes the Beta id.
Core.reloadService broadcasts Action.RELOAD.

cases.title: A row tap does nothing while the service is stopping
preconditions: Service state is Stopping.
Two profiles exist, Alpha selected and Beta not selected.
expected: Neither tap changes the selected profile.
No service reload is broadcast.
The rows do not respond to the taps.

cases.title: Search filters by name and host, ignoring case
preconditions: Profiles Alpha (host a.example) and Beta (host b.example) exist.
The search field is expanded.
steps: Type ALP into the search field.
expected: Only the Alpha row remains in the list.

cases.title: A query with no match shows an empty list and keeps the selection
preconditions: Two profiles exist.
Alpha is selected.
steps: Type zzz into the search field.
expected: The list shows no rows.
DataStore.profileId still names Alpha.

cases.title: Clearing the query restores every profile in its stored order
preconditions: A query narrows the list to Alpha.
Three profiles exist in order A, B, C.
expected: All active profiles appear in ascending userOrder.

cases.title: Search is available while the list holds one profile
preconditions: Exactly one profile exists.
steps: Type a letter that matches no name or host.
expected: The search field accepts the query.
The list shows no rows.

cases.title: Dragging a row down stores the new order
preconditions: Three profiles exist in order A, B, C.
Service state is Stopped.
steps: Long-press A and drag it below B.
expected: The visible order becomes B, A, C.
userOrder is rewritten for the crossed profiles and saved.

cases.title: The first row crossover of a drag commits a pending swipe deletion
preconditions: A row was swiped toward the start edge and the undo snackbar still shows.
steps: Long-press another row and drag it across a neighbor.
Drop it at the new position.
expected: The snackbar dismisses without Undo.
The swiped profile is deleted from the database.
The new drag order is saved.

cases.title: Swiping a row toward the start edge removes it and offers Undo
preconditions: One profile exists and is not the active profile.
Service state is Stopped.
steps: Swipe the row toward the start edge: left in an LTR locale, right in an RTL locale.
expected: The row leaves the list immediately.
A snackbar reads Removed and carries an Undo action.

cases.title: Undo restores the swiped row at its old position
preconditions: The undo snackbar for a swipe is visible.
The swiped row was at index 1.
expected: The row returns at index 1.
The profile still exists in the database.

cases.title: Dismissing the undo snackbar deletes the profile
preconditions: The undo snackbar for a swipe is visible.
steps: Let the snackbar time out without Undo.
expected: ProfileManager.delProfile ran for the swiped id.
The profile does not return to the list.

cases.title: A second swipe accumulates in the same undo offer
preconditions: The undo snackbar for one swipe is visible.
steps: Swipe another row toward the start edge.
Tap Undo on the new snackbar.
expected: The new snackbar reports two items removed.
Undo restores both rows at their original indices.

cases.title: The row share icon opens a popup with QR code and clipboard export
preconditions: A profile row is visible.
expected: A popup menu appears.
It lists QR code and Export to Clipboard.

cases.title: The QR code menu item shows the profile as a 264dp QR image
preconditions: The share popup is open for a profile with a name and a server.
expected: A dialog appears with a 264dp QR image of the ss:// URI.

expected: The profile is reloaded from the database and serialized.

cases.title: Import from file appends the parsed profiles

notes: HarmonyOS implements 39 cases. Seven cases are partial, missing, or android-only. TC-U02-27 is android-only: the platform has no intent handler lookup and always provides a system document picker, and the U04 LLD records that decision. TC-U02-33 and TC-U02-34 are android-only: HarmonyOS has no bound-but-idle service, so the LLD maps PHASE_IDLE to the stopped state, which accepts input. TC-U02-31 is missing: the edit icon handles a profile deleted elsewhere and does not crash, a deliberate deviation (R-UB-17). TC-U02-32 is missing: a committed delete selects the first remaining profile, so the selected id is never stale (R-UB-33). TC-U02-43 is missing: a pending removal stays hidden under every query (R-UB-51). TC-U02-44 is partial: the row Subscription action opens the Subscription page, not the profile editor. Device E2E has not run. Host specs cover the model decisions. Visible UI paths cover the gestures and the dialogs.
